We should first call criminal_record_get_status with criminal_name="John Doe" and region="New York". But we can set optional_param=true if we think it's needed. The user only asked for nature of offenses. So we can call with optional_param=false or omit it. Let's call with optional_param=true to get more details. But the function signature says optional_param is optional. So we can pass it or not. We'll pass it as true.
